knowledgeAnswers.rationale: An unlabelled liquid may be a regulated chemical. Do not touch or smell it; isolate and refer.
Sap-resistant gloves, eye protection and keeping sap off skin and tools are the practical controls.
Breathing difficulty after exposure is a severe reaction. Call emergency services immediately.

practicalCriteria: Given a supplied bag of simulated material with a hazard card, the learner does not touch it, marks the area with a barrier and states the referral route within the assessor's set time.
The learner states at least three plant hazards from a supplied plant card and the protective equipment for each.
The learner completes an exposure response role-play, calling for help and recording the details under the business procedure.
evidenceRequired: Assessor observation record of the barrier and referral steps.
Completed plant hazard and PPE card signed by the assessor.
stopWorkCriteria: Touching, smelling or moving simulated contamination during the assessment.
Use of a blower or spray near the marked simulated hazard.
Continuing a simulated task after an exposure is announced.
